internship.title: More ways to understand the person using the system.
internship.copy: The planned Psychology second major is not a departure from technical work. It is a way to study perception, behavior, and evidence more carefully alongside software and human-centered design.

target.copy: Residents in the early questionnaire knew nearby stores and amenities only moderately well. That observation became a fixed neighborhood map with category filters and walking-time zones.

ticket.copy: The project also left the screen. One intervention addressed leftovers and food-safety misconceptions among older residents; another focused on recognizing fraud and protecting property.
